30: Fix: Re-enable LoginRequiredException in enable() so plugin prompts login on activation.
29: Feature: Channel content search now exposes sort order, release-date, duration, and content-type (Video/Audio/Picture/Text) filters via getSearchChannelContentsCapabilities.
28: Fix: Rewrite getSearchCapabilities using class constructors (ResultCapabilities/FilterGroup/FilterCapability) matching the soundcloud plugin pattern so filter UI renders.
27: Debug: Log when getSearchCapabilities is invoked.
26: Fix: getSearchCapabilities returns plain objects instead of non-existent ResultCapabilities/FilterGroup classes so the filter UI renders.
25: Fix: Declare VIDEOS as a search feed type so Grayjay renders the filter UI.
24: Feature: Search now supports sort order, release-date filter, and duration filter via getSearchCapabilities.
23: Fix: Search suggestions now use /v3/content/search - one HTTP call per keystroke instead of 1+N.
22: Fix: Global search now uses /v3/content/search endpoint - one HTTP call instead of N+1 fan-out across every creator.
21: Fix: Home feed now correctly uses POST for batch content fetch, enabling pagination.
20: Improve: Playback tracking now fetches saved progress on init and reports final position on exit.
19: Feature: Home feed now shows all creators via browse endpoint.
18: Feature: Enable Search, Channel Contents Search, and Search Suggestions.
15: Fix: Subscription state now correct for all sub-channels.
14: Fix: Subscription feed now populated via getUserSubscriptions.
Fix: getChannel URL now uses correct channel urlname.
